aggregates.metric_scope: Macro P/R/F1 over eligible episodes; micro counts also shown. Per-type groups include truth or predictions of that type.
aggregates.return_scope: Always the original whole-episode common return; no additional per-type reward is defined.

elapsed_scope: Preflight, all runs/pairs/replays, and main artifact serialization; final manifest and atomic publication excluded.

mutations.classification: Only call-phase AssertionError failures count as semantic kills. Import, setup, runtime exception, crash, timeout, output limit and missing-test errors are invalid.
